_note: Each design is a named, defined, claim-paired unit. Tiers reference files under benchmark/sample/. A design defines which files sit ALWAYS-ON (loaded every turn) vs ON-DEMAND (loaded only when triggered) vs PER-PROJECT (skill metadata always, body on demand). run_designs.py measures each against the sample corpus and checks the claim.

L0_monolithic.definition: No tiering. All steering (with full governance/formatting detail) plus all project bodies loaded every turn.
L0_monolithic.claim: Baseline: highest per-turn tokens; full rule detail present.

L1_2location.definition: Two locations: steering always-on (full detail) + per-project skills (metadata always, one active body on demand). On-demand rule tier does NOT exist yet.
L1_2location.claim: Lower than monolithic: inactive project bodies deferred; but steering still carries full rule detail.

L2_3location.definition: Three locations: lean steering always-on + separate on-demand tier (governance/formatting/cross-links deferred) + per-project skills. Rule detail moved off always-on; one-line stubs kept.
L2_3location.claim: Lower always-on than 2-location; all must-fire rules still fire via stubs (firing integrity full).

L3_depth_safe_frontier.definition: 3-location plus protection-track detail also deferred to on-demand (compact list + stubs kept always-on). The measured safe frontier.
L3_depth_safe_frontier.claim: Lowest always-on among SAFE designs; firing integrity still full (all must-fire rules bind).

L4_full_stack.definition: L3 depth-safe tiering (rule-tiered + context-tiered) PLUS project-scoped steering loader (active project's debug/research rules loaded on demand, not always-on) AND kiro default-resource inheritance DISABLED (chat.disableInheritingDefaultResources=true) so no AGENTS.md/README/duplicate-steering is auto-appended on top. This is the user's tested end-to-end configuration.
L4_full_stack.claim: MEASURED-ON-SAMPLE: matches L3 always-on/per-turn on this corpus (same tiering) with firing integrity full. REAL-DEPLOYMENT CLAIM (user-tested, to be reproduced as a committed probe): with kiro_default inheritance OFF + project-scoped loader, this config was least-token, lossless, and factuality=100 on the user's own projects - because disabling inheritance removes the auto-appended default resources that the L0-L3 sample corpus does not model. NOTE: the sample benchmark cannot measure the inheritance-off saving (no default resources in the sample); that saving + the factuality/lossless result must be captured by a real-deployment probe, not this sample run.
